tests_may_change_note: None: the change is automatic only when a request id is set, and no existing logger or timing test sets one; a correct fix adds tests and changes none. Checked against the blind fix as well.

naive_patches.naive-logger.patch: Reads the request id once, before the rest of the chain runs, so with the logger registered first the outgoing line has no id.
naive_patches.naive-timing.patch: Writes the id into Server-Timing without escaping, so an id with a quote or backslash breaks the header.

hidden_tests_note: Exact lines and headers, with the logger's elapsed time and colour codes matched by pattern; no test depends on timing. Audit B added two checks folded into failing tests: an empty or non-string id is no id, and reqid stays last when a timer the handler left open is ended by the middleware.
scripts_cannot_see: A run that adds an option (default on) without asking passes every script check; only the judges and the T6-option-plan reply can see it.
